newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - July 31.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - July 31.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Thursday:
* A fresh cut in overnight rates and a sharp gain in Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co ADRs last night are likely to bring some cheer to a directionless market, brokers said.
* Investors await the earnings results of big cap issues such as PLDT which is expected to help prop up the market, Mayenne Katimbang, research head at Magnum International Securities said.
